(769)༄༅/ /zhing skyong chen po k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bskur chog bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (769)༄༅// zhing skyong chen po k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bskur chog bzhugs so//

(770)༄༅// na mo ma hā kā la ye/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po shin tu drag por sprul pa'i zhing skyong chen po k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin par byed pa la/ stegs kyi khar chos 'byung gru gsum phyi nag nang dmar ba'i nang du tshom bu nag po gnyis bkod/ de'i steng mañji'i khar gtor ma zung gsum gnyis sha khrag gis sbags pa dar nag gis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zur gsum gnyis dang mchod rdzas bying sha chen dang gu gul gyi dud pas hrul ba bcas legs par bsham/ rang mgon po gtso rkyang du bskyed la bzlas pa dang mchod bstod byas rjes mdun gyi mchod gtor rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gnod sbyin dpag tu med pa'i dbus su k+ṣiṃ las k+ṣe tra pā la sku mdog char sprin ltar nag shing cung zad dmar ba/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la gdengs nas lha srin sde brgyad thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ g.yon dgra bo'i snying khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bzung nas zhal du gsol ba zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i tshul gyis dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ dar nag gi ang rag gsol ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu blta ba/ khro gnyer smin brag tu bsgril nas zhal rab tu gdangs nas ljags glog ltar bskyod pa/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing zhal nas khrag gi sbu ba 'khyil ba/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung chen po 'tshubs pa/ sbom zhing thung la yan lag rags pa/ bsus khyim che ba/ ral pa kham ser gyen du me ltar 'bar ba phyag g.yon gyis spre'u 'jigs pa'i gzugs can 'khrid pa/ de'i g.yon du ma mo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas lha mo dus mtshan ma nag mo bya (771)rog gi gdong pa can sku la dar nag gi 'jol ring gsol ba/ phyag g.yas nad rkyal dang*/

g.yon ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ zangs kyi sder mo can/ shin tu khros shing 'jigs pa'i gad mo rgod de gcer bur rgyu ba/ spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khrugs pa/ skad cig tsam gyis dgra bgegs thal bar byed pa/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ e h+ye hi dza dzaḥdza ཿhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bul/ snying po'i mjug tu ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ mgon po'i bka' nyan kun gyi gtso bo khyod/ ces sogs kyis bstod/ yab yum gnyis kyis rang mgon por gsal ba la gyen du bltas te bka' nyan par bsam la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bigh+nān hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la yak+sha dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi tsit+ta la dun dun rbad/ ces dang*/ yum la/ rak+mo nag mo dam nyams kyi tsit+ta la rbad kha la phur ya swā hā/ zhes ci mang bzlas la mchod bstod bya/ slob ma'i don tu gsol ba btab/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi ni/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul// bla ma ye shes mgon po che// dus 'dir bdag la dgongs su gsol// zhing skyong drag po yab yum gyi// bka' gtad bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas gsal btab la/ rgyun bshags bya/ bla ma rin po che bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po/ (772)bshan pa kun gyi gtso bo/ za byed kun gyi dmag dpon/ k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyi gsol ba lan gsum bya/ de nas slob ma mgon po dang mdun du k+ṣe tra pā la yab yum bskyed/

bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas gnod sbyin dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i mdun gyi gnod sbyin yab yum gyi thugs kar thim de'i thugs ka nas kyang sku dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim par bsam la/ sha chen dang gu gul gyi dud pa btang*/ rol mo dang bcas pa'i snying po'i mthar a wā+e sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod sku'i rjes gnang song ngo*// yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mdun gyi gnod sbyin yab yum gyi zhal nas sngags phreng bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim pa sogs snga ma bzhin gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa sogs pa sku'i rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ gnod sbyin yab yum slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mgon po'i sku che ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa byon/ slob ma dang gnod sbyin yab yum gyi spyi bor zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa la mos gus dung dung byas pas/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung lus thams cad khyab pas bar chad thams cad bsal/ nus mthu ma lus thob/ mthar de nyid 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim/ spos rol sogs gong bzhin bya/ gri gug dang thod khrag nad rkyal ru mtshon rnams snying po 'don cing lag tu gtad thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// bla ma mgon por gsal bas gnod sbyin yum gyi phyag gnyis nas bzung ste slob ma'i lag par gtad par bsam (773)la gtor ma gnyis slob ma'i lag tu gtad la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang*/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'dis sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du phyi bzhin tu rgyug cig /'gal rkyen thams cad sol cig /phrin las thams cad sgrubs shig

/ces bka' bsgo lan gsum byas la bkra shis brjod/ gtong rag gi mchod bstod sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de ltar rjes gnang 'di gsum po mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du chig brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa dang*/ rjes gnang gi yi ge tho tsam zhig las gsal po mi bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis bla ma mgon po la gsol ba btab ste rang gi bla mas ji ltar gnang ba dang gzhan nas kyang cung zad kha bskangs te gsal por bkod pa la bla ma mgon pos bzod ngar mdzod cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
